changelog:
- Initial release of Danish News Aggregator.
- Aggregates 100+ Danish RSS feeds into 7 unified, category-based RSS feeds.
- Features automatic refresh every 15 minutes, deduplication of articles, and source authority ranking.
- Supports category feeds: national, regional, sports, business, tech, and English-language Danish news.
- Outputs RSS 2.0 compliant feeds with UTF-8 encoding and media support.
